newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: U.S. sailors charged with raping Australian girl.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sailors charged with raping Australian girl.

text.p: Three U.S. sailors were remanded in custody in a Perth court on Friday after being charged with raping a 15-year-old Australian girl in a hotel room two days before their warship was due to leave port.
The sailors, from the aircraft carrier USS Constellation, were arrested and charged on Tuesday with 15 sexual offences against the girl in a Perth hotel on Monday.

Damian Hargrave, 19, Darrell Benson, 20, and Timothy Tolbert, 24, appeared in the Perth Magistrates Court in Western Australia state on Friday and were remanded in custody until May 19 when they will apply for bail.
The Constellation left an Australian naval base in Perth without the sailors on Wednesday after the commander ordered them to remain at the base until Australian police completed investigations.
